name: (ADFS) Cleanup
description: Dead image-style detection, orphan-file management, bulk orphan deletion, filename sanitisation and file tools for managed files. A thin routing-only sub-module whose controllers and forms live in the parent Advanced Filesystem namespace.
project_description: The Cleanup sub-module of Advanced Filesystem groups the project's file-cleanup tools behind their own admin menu. It is a thin module that ships only routing, menu links and local tasks; every controller and form it references lives in the parent advanced_filesystem namespace. It exposes Orphan & Retention settings, a Bulk Delete Orphans batch form, a File Tools form (dedup resolver / metadata stripper / filename sanitiser), and Dead Image Styles reporting with per-style and bulk flush/delete routes. Orphan and file-tools routes sit under /admin/config/media/advanced_filesystem/*, and dead-style routes under /admin/reports/advanced_filesystem/*; all are gated behind the parent module's restricted 'administer advanced filesystem' permission. The menu group also links to the Ghost file scan and Private file access routes provided by the parent module.
